name: Green Locker
description: A green locker marked NORTH located at the ferry pier. It is unlocked with a brass key and contains a small metal cash box. The locker serves as a secure storage location for sensitive items.
narrative_significance: The green locker functions as a dead drop or secure exchange point in the story's mystery. It contains a cash box with a photograph of two children beside a ferry and a storage receipt, suggesting it holds clues related to the narrative's central mystery. The locker's use by Lena indicates it is part of a larger scheme or investigation involving hidden information and covert communication.
